description: This file defines the declaration of the FrontPanelConfig class, which manages front panel text displays and indicators in a device settings context. It includes class methods, private members, and references external header files for related classes.

classes.name: FrontPanelConfig
classes.description: A singleton class that manages front panel indicators, text displays, and colors, providing accessors and initialization methods.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of FrontPanelConfig.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Retrieves a color by index or by name.

methods.name: getIndicator
methods.description: Retrieves an indicator by index or by name.

methods.name: getTextDisplay
methods.description: Retrieves a text display by index or by name.

methods.name: getColors
methods.description: Returns a list of all colors.

methods.name: getIndicators
methods.description: Returns a list of all indicators.

methods.name: getTextDisplays
methods.description: Returns a list of all text displays.
